text:
Omar N: Hi all, first-week question. I can access staging console but hitting a 403 on https://console.redwood when I try to view Admin -> Feature Flags. My manager Zoe asked me to verify a prod-readonly view for a runbook demo later. Who handles prod-readonly grants?
Zoe P: @Omar N welcome! Prod-readonly is stricter. You need manager + security sign-off. Usually we grant a prod-viewer role that only allows viewing flags and audit logs, no toggles. File a ticket and tag Security.
Onboard Bot: Quick checklist: 1) open infra access ticket 2) include Okta username 3) attach manager approval screenshot 4) specify duration and purpose (e.g., runbook demo 1 hour) 5) request exact entitlement name (prod-viewer).
Omar N: Filed REQ-90011 (okta: omar.n@redwood.dev) and added "prod-viewer for runbook demo 2024-07-02 15:00 UTC".
Infra Team: We don't grant prod write roles lightly. For prod-viewer we need Security ack + a short justification in the ticket. We'll also attach a temporary session that expires.
Security Squad: Confirmed. We'll do a quick risk check. Two things: 1) prod-viewer can still read flag keys and audit logs, 2) please do not copy audit tokens out of the console. We'll approve once the ticket has the demo runbook and the exact times.
Omar N: Added the runbook and time window (60 minutes) to REQ-90011. Also noted no toggles, just view and export of the audit snippet for the demo.
DevEx Bot: FYI: If you want a prod-like read-only demo without involving prod, consider using a masked-prod clone (prod-clone-readonly) — infra can provision a replica with scrubbed PII. That avoids strict approval. See https://go/redwood-devex/prod-clone.
Zoe P: Good point. Since this is a runbook demo, do we prefer the masked clone or prod-viewer? Omar, what do you need to show?
Omar N: I need to show the audit trail for a recent toggle and the flag rollout config UI, nothing that touches live traffic. If a masked clone shows the same UI and audit format, that would be ideal.
Infra Team: Masked clone is faster and less approvals. We can spin up a timed prod-clone-readonly for a 2-hour window. It'll contain scrubbed audit entries and identical UI. Would you like us to do that instead of prod-viewer?
Omar N: Yes please — masked clone sounds perfect. Less paperwork and safer.
Security Squad: Approving masked prod-clone for demo. No tokens from the clone may be used outside the demo. We'll keep a note in the ticket.
Infra Team: Provisioned prod-clone-readonly for omar.n@redwood.dev for 2 hours starting at 2024-07-02T15:00:00Z. Access URL: https://console.clone-prod.redwood. Please validate these steps during your demo: ```bash
export REDWOOD_TOKEN=... # use token from console API Keys page in clone UI
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://api.clone-prod.redwood/health | jq .status
# then open Admin -> Feature Flags -> open flag myteam/myfeature -> open Audit -> export last 10 entries
```
Omar N: I can access the clone now and see Admin -> Feature Flags. I verified the UI and audit export flow. Health check returned "ok". Thanks, infra! :tada:
Zoe P: Excellent. We'll use the clone for the runbook demo. Omar, if you later need real prod-viewer for a compliance reason we'll run the full approval flow.
DevEx Bot: Note for new hires: masked clones are recommended for demos and training. Docs: https://go/redwood-devex/clone-howto.
Omar N: Demo prep complete. Closing REQ-90011 and documenting steps in the runbook. Appreciate everyone's help.
